text: DII 100% Cotton, Machine Washable, Dinner, Summer & Picnic Tablecloth, 60x84", Navy & Cream Buffalo Check, Seats 6 to 8 People b. the colors are no more vibrant than the photos, they are kind of muted like they have washed many times. because they are not heavy weight you do need to iron them and I recommend not letting them sit in the clothes dryer or you will not get them unwrinkled - I would not recommend using a super hot iron.

product_metadata.title: DII Buffalo Check Collection, Classic Farmhouse Tablecloth, Tablecloth, 60x84, Navy & White Check
features: SEATS 6-8 PEOPLE: 60x84" tablecloth fits a table that seats 6-8 people or layer on larger table as well; Dress our navy blue and white checkered tablecloth up or down, use indoors every day, for parties or outdoors for picnics and barbecues

EASY CARE: 100% cotton with 1" hem. Machine wash in cold water separately, gentle cycle, tumble dry low. Low iron if needed. Cotton may shrink; Style your kitchen with gingham table runners and buffalo check table runners to create a farmhouse style

ADDS A FINISHING TOUCH: Our colorfast wrinkle resistant navy blue checkered tablecloth allows your dinnerware to stand out, making a statement; Our buffalo check table accessories come in a variety of colors and sizes, allowing you to mix and match

FARMHOUSE DECOR: A classic staple for any kind of entertaining, our cotton tablecloth will add a rich, finished look; For use on dining, foyer or coffee table to brighten up any space; Any piece from our Buffalo Check Collection would make a lovely gift
